term: Invitation to the New Church (the work)
headwords: Invitation to the New Church (the work)

english: Invitation to the New Church (the work)

contexts.text: (Date of this Work implied.) Inv 33. Inv 43.

If this little Work is not added to the former one, the Church cannot be healed. It would be like a palliative cure only, a wound in which the corruption remains and eats away the neighbouring parts. Orthodoxy is this corrupt matter; and the doctrine of the New Church does indeed apply a remedy, but only outwardly.
